units.dp: Android logical density-independent pixel; base logical unit when generating CSS px or Apple points; retain responsive layout and safe areas.
units.sp: Android scalable pixel at fontScale 1; honor system text scaling on every platform.

notes: Flat dotted names are stable identifiers; a generator can emit CSS variables, Swift constants or Kotlin properties.
tv and touch are intentional current differences, not an instruction to merge the designs.

No application-defined screen-transition tween exists in the audited sources. TV widget timings are resolved from the pinned library; phone widgets retain their native Material3 interaction animations, whose spring timing is not a fixed duration.
The dimension.* primitive inventory includes sizes, borders, radii and breakpoints as well as spacing. Prefer semantic space.*, size.*, radius.*, focus.* and breakpoint.* roles.
Source markers tv: and touch: resolve relative to the corresponding pinned repository commit. Library markers resolve inside the pinned source JAR.
Inherited Material tokens are values, not copied implementation source. System font rendering, native accessibility outlines and system caption preferences can change effective rendering.
